assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

basic-turn is the smallest round-trip: one plain-text prompt, one assistant reply, no tool. On OpenCode 2.x the API driver prompts a service-hosted session (POST /api/session/{id}/prompt) and waits for a NEW time_idle on its session_v2 row. The daemon's 2.x reader admits the session on its first activity, binds it to the service pid, drives ready/working from session_message activity, and ends the turn on the plugin's session.execution.succeeded hook (#2108) — the store's own idle row lands 60–460 ms later (#2115), which the daemon reads as a sub-second ready → working → ready bounce. P4's QA run measured this arc live on the sandbox service (S1: working → ready).

## Spec choices

- Birth is a transcript_new, not a ready state: P4 first sampled an API session as working.
- The turn end is the plugin's Stop hook (hook_received) plus ready; the bounce after it is not asserted against, and no duration is asserted on the hook-ended ready (#2109 §Dwell and bounce, maintainer Q2 default: record and anchor).
caveats: The bounce after a hook-ended turn is a known daemon behaviour (#2109 §6 Q2); the spec anchors past it rather than asserting it away.
Goldens replay the exported final rows only (transcript-only replay), so they never contain the bounce.

sources.note: 2.x reader: session_v2/session_message; a session is admitted on its first activity while a service is up (#2107)
servicePIDFor: a session no client runs binds to the one running service
2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)
P4 QA run on the sandbox service: S1 working → ready, S2 working → waiting → ready, S3 interrupted → ready, all on the service pid

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Splash model at 127.0.0.1:8085); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
One send, wait for the store's new idle, then 6s so the daemon's final transitions flush

script.text: Reply with exactly the word: ok

verify: a ses_… transcript_new for the API session
pid_discovered binds it to the service pid
working, then the plugin's Stop hook_received and ready on the same session
no waiting at any point (no tool, no ask)
